description: All actions ChatWonder can dispatch to the mirror-app frontend via the chatwonder_response socket event.

actions.description: Navigate the kiosk to a specific app route

payload.route: string — must match a route from navigation.json

actions.description: Speak text to the user via browser TTS. No page state is changed.
Dispatch a named event to the currently active page. Used to update page state from ChatWonder.

payload.payload: object — shape defined per event below

event-setup.description: Move the conversation to a specific step

payload.step: event | event_type | datetime | location | weather | confirm

event-setup.description: Set a specific collected data field
Confirm the summary and navigate to the kiosk

actions.description: Save the collected event to the kiosk Calendar. Triggered automatically on confirm_event intent.
Pin the event location on the kiosk Maps view. Triggered automatically on confirm_event intent.

payload.query: string — location as spoken by user
payload.label: string — eventName, used as pin label on the map

actions.description: Show directions to the event location on the kiosk Maps view.
